title: Prove exact matrix-tensor determinant images and SL orbit counts
body:
## Summary

A scoped algebraic proof determines the ordered covariant stabilizer determinant image for multiplication in M_n(F_q), for every n>=1 and every finite field.

```text
H_n = {a^n : a in F_q*}
Delta(mu) = {(u,v,(uv)^-1) : u,v in H_n}
SL orbits inside GL orbit = (q-1) gcd(n,q-1)^2
```

The proof also constructs attaining stabilizers and corrects a supplied GL transporter to an SL transporter exactly when its determinant triple belongs to the required image. Under an explicit orbit promise, dimensions and q suffice to extract the three character equations. This adds the noncommutative full-matrix-algebra case of David Ganz's atlas A030 proposal. It is an original derivation for this repository; global literature priority is unclaimed.

Only six files in `research/matrix-tensor-determinant-image/` are added. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit David Ganz #2849 for A019/A029/A030, Nick Petalas #5252 for the finite-etale extraction precedent, and the classical matrix-unit innerness and cyclic-group arguments. The atlas retains the Chen, Grochow, Qiao, Tang and Zhang tensor-action context. Predecessors are cited without executable replay or an audit claim.

## Evidence

Before, the cited promise-class extraction results do not supply this noncommutative matrix-algebra image. After, `PROOF.md` gives a self-contained all-field argument, the exact orbit count and explicit correction witnesses.

Local CPython 3.12.15 warning-strict normal and optimized checks pass, with identical generated hash-bound receipts. Each direct check takes about 1.2 seconds; these are check durations, not performance claims. The registered runner passes both commands. Exact finite corroboration includes:

- 21 contexts at q=2,3,4,5,7,8,9 and n=1,2,3; 537 attaining stabilizers; all 142,126 literal transformed tensor coefficients.
- A separate complete 65,536-map binary domain, finding 20,160 invertible maps and exactly six matrix-algebra automorphisms, equal to the inner maps.
- All 1,171 n=2 determinant triples in those fields, with 89 explicit SL corrections and 1,082 criterion rejections. This is a determinant-domain census, not a whole-transporter or whole-orbit enumeration.
- Twelve semantic and boundary controls, including the inverse-input convention, both character restrictions, an altered tensor factor, extension fields, n=1 and q=2.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/matrix-tensor-determinant-image/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/matrix-tensor-determinant-image/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/matrix-tensor-determinant-image
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/matrix-tensor-determinant-image --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 installation can replace the interpreter path. Expected markers are `PASS_MATRIX_TENSOR_DETERMINANT_IMAGE no_new_kappa`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The direct verifier uses the standard library and writes no files. Its generated receipt binds all six package files. `SOURCES.json` binds the atlas and etale predecessor as historical provenance; there are no external executable inputs. At contribution commit `571194d4ce2a1ae5473a0fe9ff6d71384d877bcd`, committed-byte/source-history preflight and official export integrity pass. Both direct checks also pass in a read-only Git-free export with an empty PATH, in 1.17 and 1.20 seconds. Their receipts equal the final registered receipt, and all seven exported files retain their bytes. Syntax, bounded-function inspection and `git diff --check` pass; the longest function has 29 lines.

Canonical main was refreshed before submission and remains `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priority revision 8. The selected source-binding orientation passed; it is metadata orientation, not a scientific supplier replay. `TASK.json` explicitly records the changed card scope. Live PR bodies, handoff claims, local reservations, main README terms and merged searches were checked. Sparse local-note coverage is incomplete, and the searches do not prove global novelty.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19214431).

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The tensor action is K-linear with ordered factors. No factor permutations or semilinear action is included. Extraction assumes the matrix-multiplication orbit promise. Constructive correction requires a literal source or supplied multiplication chart and an existing GL transporter. Raw-tensor recognition and chart recovery remain unproved. Finite execution corroborates the written universal proof; it is not formal proof-kernel verification.

No physical supplier, native implementation, full compiler, precision/stock invoice, new kappa or complete multiplication theorem is supplied. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Lean, Docker and selected scientific cold replay were not run. Every registered command runs locally.

## Open next questions

- Derive the image for products of full matrix algebras over finite extensions. Start with one extension-field block, then include permutations of identical blocks. Extension and permutation characters remain missing.
- Recognize the promised tensor class and recover a multiplication chart and transporter. Start with the three nuclei and their simple-module actions. A complete recognition and chart-recovery proof remains missing.

## Related open work

No open PR studying the ordered stabilizer determinant image of this full matrix multiplication tensor was found in the refreshed open-PR body corpus. Merged #5252 studies finite-etale multiplication; merged #5459 and #5663 study commutative Frobenius products; merged #5250 studies matrix pencils. Their objects or hypotheses differ from M_n(F_q). No numerical comparison or predecessor verification is claimed.

## CI notes

CI pending. Hosted replay has not certified this package. Local registered normal/optimized replay passes; no check is waived.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast radius:** isolated.

This adds one self-contained research package. Shared implementation, frozen evidence and the selected result are unchanged.
